svg.title: The built-in types as sets. Values are primitives or objects. Among the primitives, int is inside ratio, inside real, inside complex. rand-seed is the same set as int. unit, the reals from 0 to 1, is inside real and overlaps int and ratio. angle, a modular type, is separate from the numbers. bool, string, color, point, none and each list type, such as list[T1] and list[T2], are separate. Among the objects, shape and movement sit side by side: every shape type and every motif type is inside shape, every animation type is inside movement, and every variant is inside the motif or the animation that it is a variant of. ease, curve and colormap are inside func, font is inside record, and scene, formula and term are separate. page-object holds component, which holds view and control, and listener. writer holds control and listener.
